title: The labeled-response module in UnrealIRCd 6.0.0 before 6.2.7.1 does not escape the IRCv3 "label" message tag when…
description: UnrealIRCd versions 6.0.0 up to but not including 6.2.7.1 contain a vulnerability in the labeled-response module where the IRCv3 "label" message tag is not properly escaped. This flaw allows any user on a network with two or more linked servers to inject server-to-server commands that execute with server authority.
